notes.title: The Prisoning: Fletcher's Quest demo is now available!
notes.content: [p][b]Hello you lovely people![/b][/p][p]I bet you thought we were gone right? Well, you’re out of luck because we’re back with a demo for our new game! As you most likely know since you’re on this site we have a new game called The Prisoning: Fletcher’s Quest and we just dropped the demo! Feel free to give it a spin and let us know what you think. If you’re lucky we might be able to fix whatever problems you might run into before the Steam Next Fest kicks off next week![/p][p]In the demo you’ll be able to try an area, some enemies and fight a giant shark boss. Here’s what a tester said about the demo boss in our closed beta - [i]“I felt like the game teetered into the frustratingly annoying area of the spectrum a few times. Mainly the Shark boss and final boss. The shark boss, I understood the patterns and attacks but defeating it while only being allowed one hit before death is brutal.” [/i]Don’t worry, we fixed all of this now. Trust us.[/p][p][b]And hey, we also made a new trailer for this demo. Check it out here:[/b][/p][previewyoutube="L9k8AXSknuQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2725720/The_Prisoning_Fletchers_Quest_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][b]Thanks for reading all of this and feel free to give the new demo a spin! We would appreciate it a lot![/b][/p][p]Thanks everyone![/p][p][b]Elden Pixels[/b][/p]

notes.title: New game from Elden Pixels coming Feb 29!
notes.content:
Hello you lovely people!

Thank you all for being fans of the games we've created! Without your support we wouldn't be here and be able to continue making games. It really means a lot!

We wanted to take the opportunity to announce that our next game will be the narrative adventure called [b]A Void Hope[/b] and it'll release February 29 on Steam, Switch and GOG.

[i]A Void Hope takes you on an atmospheric narrative adventure to find a cure for a collapsed city. Follow the story of a tormented couple as they try to decipher reality from nightmares and evade the shadowy threats lurking in the dark.[/i]
[list][*] Solve puzzles and find items to progress
[*] Avoid combat and embrace exploration
[*] Uncover the mystical story
[*] An evocative soundtrack by synthwave mastermind Waveshaper[/list]
Here’s the freshly made release date trailer:
[previewyoutube=HB6M_C-dz4U;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2438090/A_Void_Hope/

Although a bit different, this game is made by the same team behind our other titles and the reason we wanted to share these news is because we definitely think you can appreciate [b]A Void Hope[/b].

Thanks everyone!

[b]Elden Pixels[/b]

notes.title: Enter the mind of a game dev on the brink in The Prisoning: Fletcher's Quest
notes.content:
Elden Pixels who previously made Alwa's Awakening and Alwa's Legacy, and who are also working on A Void Hope also just announced The Prisoning: Fletcher's Quest.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2023/12/enter-the-mind-of-a-game-dev-on-the-brink-in-the-prisoning-fletchers-quest
